scenes.text: People were willing to pay sixty three percent more for furniture they built themselves.
It's called the IKEA effect, studied by researchers Norton, Mochon and Ariely.
Participants built IKEA boxes, folded origami and snapped together Lego.
Origami builders valued their own creations about five times more than non-builders did.
Your own effort makes things feel more valuable.
What's something you made that you could never throw away?

title: Why you overvalue things you built yourself 🪑
caption: The IKEA effect: in studies, people were willing to pay 63% more for furniture they assembled themselves. Effort makes things feel more valuable! 🧠
